findings.detail: Legacy Phase 4 regression fixtures reference artifacts/phase-4-prep/p4-prep-controller-issued-i01, which is absent from the authorized input commit and all locally visible Git history.

Phase 2 and Phase 2.1 regressions initially lacked numpy in the system interpreter; an isolated task-local venv was prepared without root, but the required literal python3 command still does not select it unless PATH is explicitly frozen.
